instruction: Like all the songs played so far in my spotify music player queue, including the current one.
notes: Single-app task (spotify) plus supervisor. Knowledge flow: show_profile gives the username (email), show_account_passwords the spotify password, login the token; show_current_song and show_song_queue are both required before any like_song because 'played so far' = queue prefix up to and including the current song. The queue length and current position are unknown at modeling time; the problem assumes a 5-song queue with the current song at position 3, so song-1..song-3 carry (played-so-far) and must be liked while song-4/song-5 are later queue entries that must not be liked (like-song requires played-so-far, matching the evaluation's exact-set check). Adjust the number of song objects / played-so-far facts to the real queue at runtime. supervisor-complete-task takes the three played songs as non-API record parameters with distinctness and (liked ...) preconditions so its precondition is exactly the goal conjunction; the actual call is complete_task() with no answer. Nothing is logged in and no ids are known in :init; in-queue/current-song/played-so-far are static world facts gated by the queue-known/current-song-known lookup predicates.
